posts.title: TCL scripting in userspace
posts.description: In this blog post I’d like to take you through the process of how I added a simple way of writing scripts in MOP3 in userspace. This side-quest was also an excuse for me to slack on the USB stack (EHCI/OHCI is still work in progress) and generally I needed a simple "quick-win", because of being way too busy with private life stuff. The code for today: https://git.kamkow1lair.pl/kamkow1/mop3/src/br
